mapper.insert: INSERT INTO letters (id, title, body, lat, lng, radius_m, place_label, owner_token, username) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{body}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{radius}, #{placeLabel}, #{ownerToken}, #{username})
